title: “If your goal is to win arguments, not hearts — you’re not evangelizing, you’re advertising.”
paragraphs:
“If your goal is to win arguments, not hearts — you’re not evangelizing, you’re advertising.”
💡 Empathy isn’t optional. It’s the message and the method.

1 Corinthians 13:1 (NIV)
“If I speak in the tongues of men or of angels, but do not have love, I am only a resounding gong or a clanging cymbal.”
